headline: Bakı: urban centre with high density and comprehensive public amenities

tags.reason: Transport index is 99 with 26 metro stations and 1,374 bus stops available.
Affordability index elcatanliq is 6, indicating high property price levels.

summary: Bakı has a population of 2,356,200 with a density of 1,122 residents per square kilometre. New build apartments average AZN 2,812.5/m² while old build apartments average AZN 2,616.7/m². The neighbourhood features 14.15 groceries and 12.44 food outlets per 10,000 residents. Road infrastructure shows a paved share of 46.5% from known surfaces.
strengths: High grocery density with 14.15 per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 2.29 (14.15 per 10,000 residents; median 2.29).
Extensive transport network supported by 26 metro stations and 35 rail stations (26 metro stations; median 0).
Strong healthcare access with 2.58 hospitals per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 0.75 (2.58 per 10,000 residents; median 0.75).
weaknesses: High property prices reflected by an affordability index elcatanliq of 6 against the national median of 50 (elcatanliq index 6; median 50).
Paved road share of known surfaces stands at 46.5% with surface unknown at 80.2% (paved share 46.5%; median 4.35).
Landcover data records residential share at 24.9% while green park landcover is 1.1% (park landcover 1.1%; national median 3.89).
best_for: Urban residents seeking central amenities and metro transport.
Buyers with sufficient capital for high property price points.
